extDescription.message: Facing an AI recruiter, your own AI avatar answers on your behalf, clearly identifying itself as an AI.

rehearsalIntro.message: Test bench: this page asks for camera and microphone, shows the received stream and reads five questions aloud.

question1.message: Can you introduce yourself in a few words?

question2.message: Why are you interested in this position?

question3.message: Tell me about a project you are particularly proud of.

question5.message: Where do you see yourself in five years?

popupHintShare.message: Click the OtherSelf button in the page to share the tab's audio.

popupHintPermissions.message: Allow the camera and microphone for this site (padlock in the address bar).

popupUnavailable.message: OtherSelf can't run on this page.

popupRemoved.message: Avatar removed. Pick your camera and microphone in the platform settings.

popupErrorGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

popupPreviewHintWaiting.message: The platform hasn't asked for the camera yet.

popupPreviewHintOpen.message: Opens a window showing the image sent to the platform, unmirrored and without sound.
